prompt:
Website page design comp, desktop landscape, of the "Get Help" page of Beauty From Ashes Surgical Ministry, a Christian nonprofit offering reconstructive surgery free or at reduced cost. The visitor is someone who needs surgery they cannot afford, for themselves or their child, and may feel hesitant to ask. Show the first viewport and part of the page below it.
LAYOUT, top to bottom:
1. Header (see below), current page "Get Help".
2. A centered page title in large serif: "Help with surgery you can't afford." with a short hand-brushed cobalt dash centered under it.
3. THE FOCAL MOMENT, a letter: a single centered column of serif text at a comfortable reading size, about 60% of the page width, set like a personal letter, beginning "If you've been putting off asking," on its own line, then: "you're welcome here. Beauty From Ashes offers reconstructive surgery, free or at reduced cost, to children and adults in the Charlotte and Fort Mill area. You don't need to share our faith to receive care. It costs nothing to ask, and asking doesn't commit you to anything."
4. Beside the letter, in the right margin, three short margin notes in small sans, each with a small spaced-capital label and a thin hairline above it, aligned with the paragraphs they relate to: "COST" / "Free, or a reduced cost you can manage."; "PRIVACY" / "Only our care team sees what you send."; "HAVE READY" / "A few photos and a short description."
5. The letter continues below with the cobalt brushed button "Ask for help" closing the letter, and a small italic serif line beneath it: "You can also call us at (704) 555-0100."

VISUAL WORLD (identical to the reference images, which show the ministry's existing home page): a buff salt-glazed stoneware page ground (#d8d1c4) with a fine orange-peel texture across the whole page; iron-brown serif type (a warm book serif, regular weight only, never bold) for headings, buttons, links and quotations; a soft humanist sans in dark clay brown for body text; small spaced capitals in soft iron brown as section labels; cobalt blue (#0b3d9c) used ONLY for actions and hand-brushed strokes. Primary buttons are cobalt swatches with dry-brushed ragged edges and a white serif label. Secondary buttons are hand-inked iron-brown outline frames with an iron serif label. Text links are cobalt serif with a short hand-brushed cobalt underline stroke. Flat surfaces: no cards, no boxes, no panels, no drop shadows, no icons, no rounded corners, no gradients. Sections separate with generous space, thin iron hairlines, and occasional hand-brushed cobalt rules. Unhurried, dignified, warm, professional.
HEADER (exactly as in the reference): at left the wordmark "Beauty From Ashes" in serif with "SURGICAL MINISTRY" in small spaced capitals beneath it; nav links in serif: "Get Help", "Volunteer", "Partner", "Stories", "About"; at right "EN | ES" in small sans and a cobalt brushed "Give" button; a full-width hand-brushed cobalt rule runs under the header. The nav link "Get Help" has a short hand-brushed cobalt stroke under it marking the current page.
The reference images contribute the header, palette, ground texture, typography, buttons and brush strokes. Do NOT copy their content: no stoneware jar, no "Restoring more than what can be seen" headline, no mission quotation, no values row.
Render a crisp, legible website design comp at desktop width with every word spelled exactly as given. No lorem ipsum, no statistics, no photographs of people, no stock imagery.
